name: Creative Brief Generator
purpose: Translate brand canon plus a specific business objective into an execution-ready brief for web, campaign, social, video, deck, packaging or generated media.
triggers: concrete creative deliverable needed (a named asset, not generic ideas)
brand canon exists (at minimum strategy + verbal identity)
next step is handoff to a production agent/designer/copywriter/team
non_triggers: defining or revising brand strategy, positioning or voice
generic ideation without a concrete objective
QA of an already-produced asset against canon
minimum_inputs: brand canon (strategy + verbal identity minimum; + visual identity for visual deliverables)
quality_gates: every brand mandatory cites the canon section it came from
exactly one key message and one CTA per deliverable
every acceptance criterion is checkable by brand-quality-auditor
no claim appears without a canon or approved-offer source
a detected canon conflict is visible in unresolved, never silently resolved
stop_conditions: all three required artifacts produced, single resolved message, canon-traceable mandatories, QA-checkable acceptance criteria -> COMPLETE
canon does not cover the deliverable's required layer, or no canon supplied -> BLOCKED, name the missing canon artifact
request conflicts with a locked canon constraint canon does not unambiguously resolve -> flag in unresolved, do not silently pick a side
never present two conflicting key messages, an unsupported claim, or a canon conflict as resolved when it wasn't
